overview: This batch focuses on finalizing the ultra-endgame state by implementing deterministic compression for the 5,500-tick simulation history and optimizing the Monte Carlo survival rate calculation for 100% coverage. The goal is to achieve a zero-deadlock, fully compressed state snapshot that supports instant rewind and deterministic replay without heap fragmentation.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Heap Deterministic State Compressor
tasks.architectural_spec: Use std::array for fixed-size buffers. Implement a bitwise packing algorithm for tick states (position, velocity, health) into 64-bit integers. No dynamic allocation. Use constexpr for table lookups. Ensure all operations are noexcept.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Compress 5,500 ticks into <1MB. 2. Decompress in <1ms. 3. Zero heap allocations during compression/decompression. 4. Bit-exact match with original state.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Instant save/load times and smaller save files for faster iteration.

tasks.title: Optimize Monte Carlo Survival Rate Calculation
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement a fixed-point arithmetic engine for survival probability. Use SIMD intrinsics (SSE4.2) for batch processing of 16,500 footsteps. Cache intermediate results in a static array. Avoid floating-point division in the inner loop.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Calculate survival rate for 16,500 steps in <0.5ms. 2. 100% accuracy match with reference double-precision results. 3. No cache misses in the hot loop.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster simulation ticks and more responsive UI updates during endgame.

tasks.title: Add Deterministic Replay Checksum Validation
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement a rolling CRC32 checksum for each tick's state. Store checksums in a std::array<uint32_t, 5500>. Provide a constexpr function to validate the entire sequence against a master checksum. Handle edge cases for empty sequences.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Validate 5,500 ticks in <0.1ms. 2. Detect any single-bit flip in the state history. 3. Zero dependencies on external libraries.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Reliable save-game integrity checks and faster debugging of simulation desyncs.
